lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Vertical columns of 4 to 5 high-luminance circular clusters arranged in a repeating horizontal sequence posterior to the branchial region along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the vertical columns of blobs, creating a grid where each blob is positioned as a node within the vertical band.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature extending longitudinally across the upper flank, marked by a sharp pixel intensity gradient transition from light (dorsal) to shadow (ventral).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, diffuse high-luminance blobs scattered across the macro-mask of the visible dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast text watermark '©Ningaloo Discovery - Windcheetah' in the lower right quadrant; presence of small Echeneidae-like silhouettes near the pectoral fin.
